verifications.claim: The Oscars are held at the Dolby Theatre in Ovation Hollywood (formerly Hollywood & Highland) on Hollywood Boulevard in Los Angeles, California.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The Dolby Theatre ... is a live-performance auditorium in the Ovation Hollywood shopping mall and entertainment complex, on Hollywood Boulevard and Highland Avenue, in the Hollywood neighborhood of Los Angeles, California, United States. Since its opening on November 9, 2001, it has been the venue of the annual Academy Awards ceremony.' R2: 'The 98th Academy Awards will be held on Mar. 15, 2026 at the Dolby Theatre.' R3: 'Dolby Theatre® has hosted the annual ceremony since 2001.'
verifications.reasoning: Directly states location and confirms it as Oscars venue.

verifications.claim: Dolby Theatre has hosted the annual Academy Awards ceremony since 2001.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Since its opening on November 9, 2001, it has been the venue of the annual Academy Awards ceremony.' R3: 'Dolby Theatre® has hosted the annual ceremony since 2001.'
verifications.reasoning: Both sources explicitly state hosting since 2001.

verifications.claim: Dolby Theatre is contracted to host the annual Academy Awards ceremony through 2028.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R3: 'Dolby Theatre is proud to be home to the highest honor in filmmaking through the year 2028.'

verifications.claim: Dolby Theatre is located at Hollywood Boulevard and Highland Avenue, Hollywood, California.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'on Hollywood Boulevard and Highland Avenue, in the Hollywood neighborhood of Los Angeles, California'

verifications.claim: Dolby Theatre is a purpose-built venue for the Academy Awards.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'The theater was designed by David Rockwell ... specifically with the Oscar ceremonies in mind.' 'The theater was developed by the Academy ... to overcome logistical issues it faced hosting the Academy Awards at other venues.' R3: 'Designed with the Academy Awards broadcast in mind'
verifications.reasoning: Explicitly designed and developed for Oscars.

verifications.claim: Dolby Theatre hosts other premier live events.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'Besides the Academy Awards, the venue has hosted other concerts and theatrical performances.' Lists American Idol, America's Got Talent, Latin Grammy Awards, etc.
verifications.reasoning: Directly lists numerous other major events.

verifications.claim: Dolby Theatre is adjacent to the historic TCL Chinese Theatre.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'It is adjacent to the TCL Chinese Theatre'

verifications.claim: Dolby Theatre is surrounded by the Ovation Hollywood shopping center.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'in the Ovation Hollywood shopping mall and entertainment complex' 'The front facade of the Dolby Theatre at Ovation Hollywood, the actual theatre is at the rear of the complex.' 'hall ... is flanked by storefronts'
verifications.reasoning: Describes theatre within and at rear of the shopping complex, flanked by storefronts.

verifications.claim: The Academy Awards ceremony occasionally takes place at other venues in Los Angeles.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'with the only exception being the 93rd Academy Awards in 2021—which were ... moved to Union Station' R2: Lists numerous past venues like Hollywood Roosevelt, Biltmore, Shrine Auditorium, etc., and 2021 at Union Station. R3: Details historic venues before Dolby.
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm multiple past and one recent exception in LA.

verifications.claim: Dolby Theatre is considered the primary, consistent home of the Oscars
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1: 'it has been the venue of the annual Academy Awards ceremony' 'It has been the venue for all Academy Awards ceremonies held since [2002], with the only exception...' R3: 'has hosted the annual ceremony since 2001' 'home to the highest honor in filmmaking through the year 2028'
verifications.reasoning: Described as the venue/home since 2001/2002 with only one exception, supporting primary and consistent status.
